title: Three Smiling Siblings in Front Yard, 1962 Suburban B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic black-and-white family snapshot with scalloped edges, stamped 'SEP • 62' along the top border. Three smiling siblings pose together outdoors in a suburban front yard in front of a leafy tree. The older girl on the left wears a white collared long-sleeve top with a cross pendant necklace, the young boy in the middle sports a horizontally striped shirt, and the older boy on the right wears a boatneck shirt with asymmetrical vertical striping. Mid-century ranch-style homes line the street in the background.
